simple: A platform for the security operations center (SOC) that combines SIEM, response automation and AI. Collects logs from firewalls, the cloud, identity systems and other sources (1,100+ integrations) into the Cortex cloud data lake, normalizes and correlates them. 13,300+ built-in detectors, 2,900 of them machine-learning models, spot attacks without constant rule tuning; analytics also cover network traffic — from firewall and flow logs, without its own network sensors. Models learn the usual behavior of users and devices and raise an alert when it changes (UEBA). The system handles low-value alerts on its own and groups the rest into cases with the full attack story and a risk score. 1,000+ ready-made playbooks and Cortex Agentic Assistant AI agents enrich cases and carry out response actions in other security tools; there are reports for compliance audits. Licensed by data volume (from 100 GB per day). Every computer and server gets the Cortex XDR agent: it blocks malware, ransomware, exploits and fileless attacks, collects detailed telemetry for detection and investigation, lets you isolate a computer and work on it remotely, and controls USB drives, the host firewall and disk encryption. Host Insights finds vulnerabilities on computers, keeps an inventory of them and lets you find and destroy a malicious file on all machines at once (Search and Destroy); extended data collection supports threat hunting. Protects AWS, Azure and GCP: checks configuration and compliance (CSPM), cuts excessive permissions (CIEM), finds sensitive data (DSPM) and AI application risks, scans cloud servers for vulnerabilities, malware and exposed secrets without agents, and checks applications and CI/CD pipelines. The agent protects cloud servers, containers, Kubernetes and serverless functions at runtime, and Web and API Security blocks attacks on web applications and APIs. Unit 42 threat intelligence and your own and third-party indicator feeds are built into analytics; attack surface management finds the company's resources on the internet and alerts on their vulnerabilities. ITDR, email security, forensics, DLP, Exposure Management and code security are sold separately.
